oldClauseText: Any dispute, claim, or controversy arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be determined by arbitration in New York before a single arbitrator.
newClauseText: Any dispute, claim, or controversy arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be determined by arbitration in New York before a single arbitrator.
rationale: Exact verbatim clause text; no change whatsoever.

oldClauseText: The parties agree to resolve all disputes exclusively through confidential individual arbitration in Dover, Delaware.
newClauseText: The parties agree to resolve all disputes exclusively through confidential, individual arbitration in Dover, Delaware.
rationale: Minor comma punctuation addition with zero substantive or contractual effect.

oldClauseText: We collect information you provide directly to us when you create an account, such as your username and email address.
newClauseText: We collect information you provide directly to us when registering an account, including your username and email address.
rationale: Simple synonym swap ('create' to 'registering') without expanding data collection scope.

oldClauseText: If you have questions regarding these terms, contact our legal department at legal@company.com.
newClauseText: If you have questions regarding these terms, contact our compliance team at privacy@company.com.
rationale: Updated administrative contact email address; no change to substantive consumer rights.

oldClauseText: You may cancel your monthly subscription up to 3 days prior to the scheduled renewal billing date.
newClauseText: You may cancel your monthly subscription up to 7 days prior to the scheduled renewal billing date.
rationale: Lengthened cancellation notice deadline imposes stricter burdens on consumers to avoid auto-charges.

oldClauseText: You may opt out of this arbitration agreement by notifying us in writing within 60 days of opening your account.
newClauseText: You may opt out of this arbitration agreement by notifying us in writing within 14 days of opening your account.
rationale: Substantially cuts consumer arbitration opt-out window from 60 days to 14 days, increasing binding dispute lock-in.

oldClauseText: Either party may bring an action in any court of competent jurisdiction to enforce rights under this Agreement.
newClauseText: You agree that all disputes shall be resolved exclusively through mandatory binding individual arbitration and waive all rights to a court trial.
rationale: Replaces standard court access with mandatory binding arbitration, eliminating user constitutional trial rights.

oldClauseText: Disputes shall be handled in accordance with standard civil litigation rules.
newClauseText: You expressly waive any right to bring or participate in any class action, collective lawsuit, or representative proceeding against us.
rationale: Introduces aggressive class action waiver eliminating collective legal redress for consumers.

oldClauseText: If you cancel within 30 days of annual renewal, you are entitled to a full pro-rata refund of unspent subscription fees.
newClauseText: All subscription fees are non-refundable upon payment, and no refunds or credits will be issued for partial cancellation periods.
rationale: Completely eliminates 30-day pro-rata refund policy, substituting strict zero-refund forfeiture terms.

oldClauseText: All fees paid under this agreement are strictly non-refundable under all circumstances.
newClauseText: If you are dissatisfied with the service within the first 14 days, we will provide a full 100% refund upon written request.
rationale: Introduces a consumer-friendly 14-day refund window where none previously existed, reducing consumer financial risk.

oldClauseText: We do not sell your personal information or share personal data with external third parties without your explicit opt-in consent.
newClauseText: We may share, monetize, or sell pseudonymized behavioral profiles, purchase histories, and location data to third-party marketing brokers.
rationale: Reverses strict non-sale privacy pledge to authorize commercial data brokering and location sharing.

oldClauseText: You retain full ownership of your content and grant us a limited license solely to display your uploads within the app during your account tenure.
newClauseText: You grant us a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully sublicensable license to use, reproduce, modify, and commercialize your content.
rationale: Converts limited hosting license into perpetual, irrevocable, sublicensable commercial exploitation rights over user IP.

oldClauseText: Any change to subscription pricing requires 60 days advance written notice and requires affirmative user agreement prior to renewal.
newClauseText: We reserve the right to increase subscription fees at our discretion upon 7 days electronic notice, effective on your next billing date.
rationale: Slashes price hike notice from 60 days to 7 days and eliminates affirmative consent requirement.

oldClauseText: We may amend these terms by posting a revised agreement at least 30 days before the modifications take effect.
newClauseText: We may modify these terms at any time without prior notice, with changes taking immediate effect upon publication on our website.
rationale: Removes 30-day advance notice protection in favor of immediate unilateral modifications without notice.

oldClauseText: Our total aggregate liability for all claims arising out of this service shall be capped at $1,000 or the total fees paid in the past 12 months.
newClauseText: Our total aggregate liability for all claims arising under this agreement shall in no event exceed fifty dollars ($50.00).
rationale: Dramatically reduces maximum damages recovery cap from $1,000/annual spend down to nominal $50 cap.

oldClauseText: Neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, or special consequential damages.
newClauseText: Company shall have no liability for data loss, server downtime, security breaches, cyberattacks, or any lost profits whatsoever.
rationale: Broadens liability disclaimer to disclaim all accountability for catastrophic data loss and cyber breaches.

oldClauseText: Each party shall be responsible for its own legal compliance and costs in connection with use of the platform.
newClauseText: You agree to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless company from any third-party claims, liabilities, damages, and attorney fees arising from your use.
rationale: Imposes one-sided indemnification obligation onto consumer, forcing user to pay company legal defense costs.

oldClauseText: We may suspend your account for material breach upon 15 days written notice and opportunity to cure.
newClauseText: We reserve the right to terminate or suspend your account immediately at our sole discretion without notice or cause.
rationale: Replaces 15-day notice and cure protection with immediate at-will termination without cause.

oldClauseText: You agree to waive any right to a jury trial in any proceeding arising out of or related to these terms.
newClauseText: All disputes between the parties shall be heard before a court of competent jurisdiction under applicable state rules.
rationale: Restores full access to jury and court proceedings, removing previously enforced jury waiver.

oldClauseText: Arbitration under this section is mandatory and strictly binding on all registered users without exception.
newClauseText: You may opt out of this arbitration provision by emailing optout@company.com within 30 days of creating your account.
rationale: Grants users an accessible electronic opt-out mechanism for mandatory arbitration.

oldClauseText: You can easily cancel your recurring subscription online at any time by clicking cancel in your account settings.
newClauseText: To cancel your subscription, you must telephone our customer service center between 9am and 5pm Eastern time on business days.
rationale: Eliminates one-click online cancellation and introduces burdensome phone-only cancellation roadblock.

oldClauseText: User account records and personal data are deleted within 30 days following verified account closure.
newClauseText: We retain user records, identity documents, and usage histories indefinitely following account closure for legal compliance.
rationale: Replaces 30-day data purging commitment with indefinite permanent retention of personal records.

oldClauseText: These terms are governed by the laws of California. Venue for any judicial proceeding shall be in San Francisco.
newClauseText: These terms are governed by California state law. Any judicial proceeding shall be conducted in federal or state courts in Santa Clara County, California.
rationale: Shifts venue between adjacent Northern California counties without changing legal standard or governing jurisdiction.

oldClauseText: Subscriptions are billed on a flexible monthly basis and may be canceled at the end of each monthly period.
newClauseText: Subscriptions are billed on an upfront annual basis and auto-renew automatically every 12 months with non-refundable billing.
rationale: Converts month-to-month billing into 12-month lock-in commitment with non-refundable upfront fees.

oldClauseText: We collect technical diagnostic logs, device operating system versions, and basic crash reports.
newClauseText: We collect facial geometry, voice prints, and biometric identifiers to verify user identity and train computer vision algorithms.
rationale: Introduces invasive collection of biometric facial and voice prints for AI model training.

oldClauseText: Creators retain attribution rights and moral rights in all creative works published through the platform.
newClauseText: You irrevocably waive all moral rights, rights of attribution, and integrity rights in any content submitted to the service.
rationale: Strips creator moral rights and attribution guarantees previously protected under earlier terms.

oldClauseText: We commit to maintaining 99.9% service uptime and will provide service level credits for unexcused outages.
newClauseText: The services are provided strictly as-is and as-available, with no uptime warranties, SLAs, or outage credits of any kind.
rationale: Eliminates 99.9% SLA commitment and credit remedies, shifting all outage risk onto the customer.

oldClauseText: You represent and warrant that you own or have obtained all necessary licenses to publish your submissions.
newClauseText: You represent and confirm that you possess all necessary rights and licenses to publish your submitted materials.
rationale: Stylistic simplification of legal phrasing without changing underlying warranty requirements.

oldClauseText: Any legal claims shall be resolved in consumer courts in your state of residence.
newClauseText: All legal actions must be commenced exclusively in the courts of the Cayman Islands, and you waive all jurisdictional objections.
rationale: Moves dispute forum to distant offshore tax haven, imposing severe financial and geographical barriers on consumer claims.

oldClauseText: To delete personal data, you must mail a notarized written request with two forms of photo ID to our physical headquarters.
newClauseText: You may delete your account and request complete data purging instantly by clicking delete in privacy settings.
rationale: Eliminates hostile notarized mail requirement in favor of immediate one-click data deletion, reducing user privacy exposure.
